I LOVE BEES, so I was very pleased at the prospect of wearing them in my hair.  But these are NOT hair "clips," they are gold-colored bobby pins with pretty gold bees attached.  If that will work for you, then by all means buy them -- the quality seems good.  But if you're interested in actual CLIPS, or if you plan to use them as decoration (the gold bobby pin part of the item needs to be hidden), then pass on these.

Received ours today and cannot say I like it, will probably not give it as a gift.  Cannot say they don't look entirely like the photo, but perhaps are bigger than I thought or saw, are more painted gold look, and ultimately do not look like honey bees which was the intention (I see it was not advertised as such).  I know they are cheap so not too much complaint, I just had hoped for more.

reviews.t: Beautiful but disappointing.  Handle with extreme care!

This increases the chances of breaking the embellishment...which is a cheaper quality.  Please handle with care.  They still were very pretty and did not furnish nor change colors.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the bee pins cute, pretty, and shiny, and consider them good value for the price.
Several reviewers report very slow shipping, often taking months to arrive from China.
Some reviewers say the pins are poorly made, with gold chipping, bees falling off, or items arriving broken due to soft packaging.
A few reviewers note the pins snag or rip out hair, especially with fine hair.
Some reviewers note the pins are larger than expected and are bobby pins rather than true clips.
